tools.name: api_status
tools.title: API key status
tools.summary: Check API key tier, credit usage and remaining requests, and historyFrom, how far back events, market and calls read. Also confirms the API is reachable.

tools.name: mentions
tools.title: Mentions
tools.summary: Social mentions from X and Telegram. mode=top ranks a ticker's mentions by engagement, mode=search filters by keyword or account, mode=news returns the token news feed, which is X posts from accounts tagged as news sources rather than articles from news outlets.

tools.name: trending
tools.title: Trending
tools.summary: What is gaining social attention. scope=tokens for tickers, scope=contracts_twitter or scope=contracts_telegram for contract addresses.

tools.name: narratives
tools.title: Narratives
tools.summary: Written narrative analysis with source links. scope=market extracts market-wide narratives, scope=keywords summarises events for specific keywords.

tools.name: account_stats
tools.title: Account stats
tools.summary: Smart follower and engagement stats for an X account. Legacy: it still works, but will be removed on 28 October 2026.

tools.name: market_chat
tools.title: Market chat
tools.summary: Ask for written market analysis. Supports conversational chat, macro overview, quick summary, token intro, token analysis and account analysis.

tools.name: auto_build
tools.title: Auto query builder
tools.summary: Turn a plain-language monitoring request into an EQL query. Returns a draft to validate and activate, it does not activate anything itself.

tools.name: auto_validate
tools.title: Validate Auto query
tools.summary: Check EQL syntax and get a cost estimate before activating, or check that a symbol has market data on a venue.

tools.name: auto_query
tools.title: Read Auto queries
tools.summary: Read side of Auto: list queries, poll one query, and read its executions and LLM sessions.

tools.name: auto_query_write
tools.title: Write Auto queries
tools.summary: Activate, cancel or delete an Auto query. Activated queries run unattended and fire their action when conditions are met.
tools.credits: 5 plus LLM usage to create, free to cancel or delete

tools.name: auto_draft
tools.title: Auto drafts
tools.summary: Manage inactive Auto drafts. Drafts do not evaluate until converted into an active query.
tools.credits: Free, except convert which costs the same as creating a query

tools.name: entities
tools.title: Entities
tools.summary: Resolve a ticker, $cashtag, name, @handle, contract address, CoinGecko id, FIGI or CIK to the entity id that events and calls take. Matches exactly, it is not a search.
tools.credits: Free on PAYG and Grow until 31 Oct 2026

tools.name: events
tools.title: Events
tools.summary: What is happening in crypto and equity markets. level=events for what happened and how prices reacted, level=storylines for one development threaded over days, level=arcs for storylines grouped into a larger movement. Searchable by topic.
tools.credits: Free on PAYG and Grow until 31 Oct 2026

tools.name: market
tools.title: Market
tools.summary: Whole-market views for crypto or equities. view=mindshare ranks assets by share of attention, view=call_book is the crowd's long/short lean hour by hour, view=trending_contracts ranks contract addresses by how many posts pasted them.
tools.credits: Free on PAYG and Grow until 31 Oct 2026

tools.name: calls
tools.title: Calls
tools.summary: Positions accounts take in posts. level=calls for each post that takes or changes a position, level=episodes for each position from open to close with the author's track record, level=positioning for open longs and shorts on one asset now.
tools.credits: Free on PAYG and Grow until 31 Oct 2026

tools.name: top_accounts
tools.title: Top accounts
tools.summary: X accounts ranked by standing (how much other accounts engage with them) or, with metric, by their track record as callers (alphaScore, hitRate, avgReturn).
tools.credits: Free on PAYG and Grow until 31 Oct 2026

unexposed.note: A tool call returns one result, so streaming adds nothing. market_chat covers the same analysis.
Long lived streams have no tool equivalent. Poll with auto_query.
